### Figure ID / 图 ID

Copy the ID from the figure detail view.

### What is wrong? / 哪一处有问题？

Explain the issue and the expected correction.

### Source evidence / 原文或图面依据

Link the paper and give a page/figure number or identify the relevant image element.
Distinguish what is visible in the figure from what is stated in the paper text.

### Optional screenshot / 可选截图

Remove personal notes before posting.
